groups.summary: The restored C# receiver regression contains an extra closing brace and therefore tests malformed source.
groups.evidence: At intro, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_type/csharp.rs:773 declares file-scoped namespace Demo; Parent closes at :777 and the added brace at :778 has no opening counterpart. The malformed string is passed to AnalyzerFixture and parse_tree_for_language at :789-792, then used for this/base assertions at :794-827, without checking for syntax errors. The base lacks the extra brace. This concretely damages the intended valid-source regression; a particular parser-dependent assertion failure is not established. Later fix ed0d32a1839ea511489b54f5434477ed1516fae6 removes exactly this brace.

groups.summary: Complete-empty Java supertype answers lose their implicit nominal fallback during hierarchy traversal.
groups.evidence: At intro, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_operation/jvm_context.rs:4015-4084 registers no-gap unqualified Java type references as implicit fallbacks, choosing an available durable java.lang owner at :4041-4056. This diff changes that registration from a provider claim to ImplicitFallback. crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/selected_context.rs:1567-1569 now hides these claims from the provider getter. crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_resolution.rs:29235-29240 uses only that getter for external hierarchy inventory, so a complete-empty selected supertype answer bypasses the owner and falls through to :29303-29326, returning empty targets as Complete. Hierarchy construction consumes those targets at :31545-31580, losing inherited members/subtype edges; without indexed inventory it also loses the incomplete-inventory boundary normally added at :29280-29291. Type projection handles the same fallback correctly at :38750-38762, but hierarchy lookup has no corresponding check. Later fix 8ca7eb63803b39dd44a3774628b2f24a194351b7 shares the complete-empty fallback condition with hierarchy traversal while retaining source-declaration precedence.
